task.name: q3-report
task.goal: Create the quarterly forecast report in Acme Portal

replay_guidance: This is a recorded demonstration of a task on macOS. To replicate it: (1) Read `outline` first, then `steps`. (2) Substitute `parameters` with the values for this run; ask if a value isn't given. Steps marked `secret` were typed into password fields and were never recorded; ask the person. (3) Find each target using the most robust locator available, in order: target.element (accessibility role + title/description, scoped by target.path and the step's window), then target.ocr_label (text visible at the click point), then target.rel_xy (fraction of the window's width/height), and target.abs_xy only if the screen layout matches environment.screens. (4) After each step, confirm its `effect` (windows opened/closed/retitled) before continuing; if the effect doesn't happen, stop and re-check rather than guessing. (5) `intent` is the person's own explanation of why a step happens; it outranks your inference. (6) The task is complete when `success_criteria` holds. Steps marked `optional` did not occur in every run.
outline: 1. Click button "New Report" in Safari > Acme Portal - Reports -> opens "Report Wizard"
2. Click text field "Report title" in Safari > Report Wizard
3. Type {report_title} (e.g. "Q3 forecast") into text field "Report title" in Safari > Report Wizard
5. Type {period_end} (e.g. "2026-09-30") into text field "Period end" in Safari > Report Wizard
6. Click password field "Approval PIN" in Safari > Report Wizard
7. Type [secret] into password field "Approval PIN" in Safari > Report Wizard
8. Click button "Create" in Safari > Report Wizard -> closes "Report Wizard" -> window becomes "Acme Portal - Q3 forecast"
9. Press cmd+s in Safari > Acme Portal - Q3 forecast
